[u][b]The Sadistic High Elf Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: High Elf
Code Name: Bullseye
Second Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Wolfard
Club: Spy Swimming Club

Torenia is a second-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a high elf. She is one of the top students in the Wolfard class, which specializes in assassination and combat.

High elves are a gifted race skilled in both magic and archery, and Torenia is no exception, an outstanding honor student. She receives top evaluations across all subjects and contributes heavily to Wolfard’s class points. Her skill with the bow is especially unmatched in the academy, and she has had no real rivals since her first year.

Her personality is gentle and well-mannered, and she is well liked by both friends and teachers.…However, that is only her public face. In reality, Torenia is quite sharp-tongued and a bit scheming. She only shows this side in front of close friends, but it is said that monsters often lose their will to fight from her words before her arrows. Incidentally, she hides her true nature in front of her mother and behaves like a proper lady.

The protagonist, who came from another world, quickly becomes the perfect target for her sadistic tongue. However, since the protagonist doesn’t take it to heart and keeps making sexual advances, he’s like a natural enemy to Torenia. As their back-and-forth continues, she gradually finds herself becoming more interested in him. She may have a bit of a submissive streak.

Her codename is “Bullseye,” meaning a perfect hit. Her ability as a spy is long-range assassination through archery. She inherited her talent from her mother, a legendary sniper, and aims to follow in her footsteps.

Her boobs are S-cups, with a “long, perky bell-shaped” form. She also happens to have inverted nipples, which naturally makes her an easy target for the protagonist’s teasing in more ways than one. Her specialty in honey traps is psychological pressure using her sharp tongue. It is said to be especially effective against targets who are more receptive to that kind of approach.

Her hobbies include beauty care and delivering sadistic remarks. Her specialties are archery and swimming.

Her mother, Priscilla, is a teacher at the academy and also Torenia’s archery instructor.
She is a gentle and elegant high elf who embodies the ideal of her race, and Torenia aspires to become like her. They have a close relationship and often go shopping together on their days off.
